lifecycle.scope: Bounded evidence vocabulary for prompt handles; not a current task list or permission to run probes.

principle: A handle's presence in official examples proves accepted/recommended expression, not a quality success rate. Hard controls and probabilistic semantic handles are separated.

model_id.form: exact model ID in request model field
model_id.notes: Exact version matters; do not inherit capability from another suffix.

duration_prompt_suffix.evidence: official Ark API example + E2E across 1.5 Pro, Pro 250528, Fast 251015
duration_prompt_suffix.notes: Earlier top-level duration was confounded; prompt suffix is the documented/currently isolated production choice.

ratio_prompt_suffix.evidence: official Ark API examples; 16:9 E2E in project
ratio_prompt_suffix.notes: Only tested ratios should be treated as E2E.

single_image_url_15_pro.notes: No explicit role was needed in the successful single-image test. Do not generalize image-role semantics to every model.

silent_output_15_pro.evidence: two E2E observations with actual video-only MP4s
silent_output_15_pro.notes: Omitting the field produced real AAC audio in D-002; when silence matters, send false explicitly.

return_last_frame.notes: API docs state the PNG final frame can chain consecutive video tasks. Test only when continuity becomes load-bearing.

camera_movement.source_strength: official API example contains camera-movement language; official prompt-guide pages exist
camera_movement.what_is_proven: camera language is an intended prompt modality
camera_movement.what_is_not_proven: adherence rate, best wording, interaction with subject motion

ordered_action_sequence.source_strength: official API examples describe sequential actions; developer-community implementations explicitly recommend ordered sequencing
ordered_action_sequence.what_is_not_proven: second-level timing accuracy or stable ordering success rate

multi_shot_narration.source_strength: official Ark API request example explicitly uses '多个镜头' and camera transition language
multi_shot_narration.what_is_proven: multi-shot textual description is an intended input style
multi_shot_narration.what_is_not_proven: number-of-shot adherence, continuity quality, transition precision

identity_lock.source_strength: used in successful 1.5 Pro I2V project run
identity_lock.what_is_not_proven: whether the wording causes consistency versus the reference image/model itself; no controlled ablation yet

negative_constraints.what_is_not_proven: negative-clause causal strength or best syntax

concrete_motion_verbs.source_strength: official/community prompt practice and successful project prompts

temporal_segments.source_strength: not established by current official parsed API examples
temporal_segments.production_policy: do not claim precise timeline control until controlled tests justify it

single_image_i2v_15_pro.reason: reference image already supplies appearance/scene information; re-describing every visual detail may introduce unnecessary constraints, but this is a strategy hypothesis rather than a proven causal law

first_last_frame.production_policy: do not auto-route until exact model/mode is E2E when required

native_audio_15_pro.hard_input: audio output observed by default when generate_audio omitted
native_audio_15_pro.production_policy: explicitly disable audio for silent tasks; do not promise dialogue/SFX adherence without quality evidence

promotion_rule.candidate_to_quality_claim: requires controlled repeated samples when the handle becomes load-bearing
promotion_rule.single_failure_rule: one failed generation may update a sample record but does not universally falsify a probabilistic handle
promotion_rule.single_success_rule: one success proves reachability, not reliability
